warning_reference_test: reproduces source syllable-level calculation; syllables within six birds are not25 independent animals. Do not use as fresh bird-level inference.
bird_grouping_sign_constraint: All25 paired differences are positive, so every nonempty group mean remains positive under any grouping into birds; this does not supply missing bird-level variances or prove a population effect.

decile_response.quality_direction: not independently labeled in worksheet; first/last columns numerically reconcile with closer/farther g as a post-inspection consistency check
decile_response.time_axis: display-grid convention based on stated -1..+1sec plotting span, not raw acquisition timestamps; g scalar panel is definitive

analytical_constraint.derivation: Expand squared norm; centered Gaussian cubic moments vanish and E[epsilon_i*epsilon_j]=sigma^2 delta_ij. This covariance exists even when the song-update equation contains only the latent target, without dopamine.

claims: Definitive g pairs support the relative-quality contrast. The unlabeled decile columns are strictly ordered in source order; direction relative to quality is not independently established by worksheet labels.
These data do not manipulate tutor identity or identify how a tutor template is acquired.
Other causal studies establish pathway roles; this descriptive source-data audit does not overturn them.
